title: Bray & Cyber's Better, Fresher 3D Books (1.21 Backport)
description: Backport for 1.21 of Fresher 3D Books, originally made by Bray & Cyber.
body:
This resource pack is the backported version from **Bray's and Cyber's work**, which makes unique 3D models for every enchantment in the game with lots of neat details and animated effects!

# Why is there a backport?

Since the original work uses features from 1.21.5. That do not exist in the previous version, the models did not work correctly. Shortly after, it was announced that the original resource pack would be discontinued for previous versions to 1.21.5. That's when I decided to make myself an adaptation. Current dependencies needed (with their tested version):
- `CIT Resewn` (v1.2.0-1.2.2)
- `CITResewnNeoPatcher` if using NeoForge (latest at the moment, v1.2.0)
- `Sinytra Connector` if using NeoForge (latest at the moment, v2.0.0-beta.14)

# Are there differences with the original?

The most important limitation is that the books will always appear open, since in previous versions to 1.21.5 there is no way to assign different models to the same item, even with CIT. The 2D sprites or the closed books models do not exist.

Anyway, enjoy the resource pack and also check out the original work! [Bray & Cyber's Better, Fresher 3D Books](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/bray-cyber-3d-enchanted-books).
